verdict.rationale: Documented CPU and wall-clock execution limits are a fair question for a cloud deployment platform like Railway, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never states any function CPU or execution-time limits. The closest items describe scaling CPU and RAM and cloud agent machines that stay running after you disconnect; both are adjacent claims and say nothing about documented time limits.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the CPU and wall-clock execution time limits for functions so I can tell whether long-running or agentic workloads will fit
